headline: DBV Technologies Shares Fall on Wider Q3 Loss and Going-Concern Warning
summary: DBV Technologies shares slid 8% after reporting a wider third-quarter net loss accompanied by a formal going-concern warning.
why: Biopharmaceutical clinical-stage companies rely heavily on ongoing capital raising; going-concern warnings signal immediate liquidity and solvency risks.

impacts.name: DBV Technologies S.A.
impacts.why: Wider quarterly losses and going-concern warnings heighten investor risk perceptions regarding corporate survival.
